facts.fact: WHO Gabon's 2024 annual report states that Gabon joined the countries using DHIS2 in December 2024 through financing and technical support from WHO and the Global Fund; no domestic budget line is mentioned.

WHO Gabon states that Law 004/2022 set the legal basis for reforming the national health information system (SNIS), that a directorate dedicated to the SNIS was set up, and that a national technical committee and a steering committee coordinate DHIS2, which was launched in December 2024 before the Prime Minister.
WHO Gabon states that the SNIS directorate drew up a Strategic Plan 2024-2028 which provides for DHIS2 as the main tool for managing health data.

WHO Gabon states that at its December 2024 launch DHIS2 integrates all functional public health facilities, with extension to private facilities to follow in 2025; it names no tier and gives no count of facilities.

WHO Gabon states that the people trained to use DHIS2 in 2024 were 122 data managers and 10 regional health directors from all 51 health departments and 10 regions, equipped with 96 laptops and 122 modems; it describes no entry by facilities themselves.

WHO Gabon reports that DHIS2 was officially launched in December 2024 with 192 indicators, two online servers and one physical server, and that thirty days after launch report completeness had risen from 60% to 85% and the average transmission delay had fallen from 30 to 15 days; the report's summary gives the same rise as 60% in 2023 to 85% in 2024.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health SNIS directorate, with a national technical committee and a steering committee; WHO and Global Fund financing
systems.tiers: all functional public health facilities integrated; users trained in all 51 health departments and 10 regions; private facilities from 2025

systems.owner: not stated; set up with WHO support

note: DHIS2 is classed hmis because the document ties it to report completeness and transmission delay; it names no module. Two values are readings the parent should check: tiers rests on the phrase that the system integrates all functional public facilities, which is not a statement that each tier uses it; digitised:district rests on who was trained and equipped, the document never saying where forms are keyed. It also states that until 2023 there was no centralised mechanism for collecting and validating data and the tools were obsolete and fragmented, which fits no aspect value. Its completeness figures (60% to 85%) differ from those in document 31 (35% in 2024, 40% in 2025).
